alternative_explanations: The complete two-state machine parameterization may carry most of the solution even though it is not a four-op library; success would be finite system identification, not open-ended program discovery.
Whole-I/O supports may be behaviorally distinctive enough that classical enumeration or a signature index solves routing, while differentiable optimization adds no reusable representation.
The dense random-feature control may underfit weakly supervised recurrent behavior; enumerative MDL is the decisive exact matched baseline.
confounds: K deliberately couples unrelated meta-training experience and padded external-memory capacity as a full-system scaling test; the experiment cannot attribute a K effect to only one without a child ablation.

The benchmark is a visible binary two-state synthetic machine with one quick seed, deterministic noise and exact operation proxies; it cannot establish transfer to larger machines, language or open-world algorithms.
falsification_criteria: Make HYP-0009 dormant if learned_latent_vm is below 0.95 accuracy, length extrapolation or exact program induction in any cell; a soft output fit without recovery of the executable transition table does not pass.

Treat the learned VM as null and make HYP-0009 dormant if enumerative_mdl_vm matches its capability and is no worse on exact cold query operations, warm operations, memory reads, bytes, persistent state, fit operations and update operations.

Reject any scaling claim if learned_latent_vm omits support parsing or per-task optimization, reads padded cells without charging them, or query work/error grows materially with irrelevant K at fixed D.

outcome_policy.negative: If the learned VM fails exact induction or length extrapolation while MDL and oracle pass, make HYP-0009 dormant without tuning this toy and pivot to a different uncertain family.
outcome_policy.null: If learned latent execution is exact but explicit MDL matches or dominates its full cost, retain both as controls but make HYP-0009 dormant because a differentiable VM adds no distinct signature.
outcome_policy.positive: Keep HYP-0009 testing only if the learned latent VM recovers every unseen executable program, extrapolates exactly, has near-zero K query slope and beats enumerative MDL on at least one exact capability-cost axis without losing another; then preregister a three-seed adversarial state-count screen.

predicted_outcome: Every scored task supplies only whole input-final-output examples for an unseen binary two-state Mealy program, with one deterministically corrupted support label, no program token, state trace, action sequence or task ID; D is active tape length and K jointly scales padded external memory and the unrelated meta-training corpus. Oracle and enumerative MDL are predicted exact in every cell because the harness admits only tasks whose true program is the unique minimum-error member of the complete 256-program class. Random and nearest are near 0.50, dense whole-I/O remains below 0.90 on unseen programs, and the differentiable latent VM is predicted below 0.95 in at least one D=4/6 cell or to require more cold induction work than enumerative MDL. Direct and latent warm execution should read only D active bits with near-zero K slope, while dense reads all K cells. The expected outcome is a registered negative or null for the current learned VM, not promotion.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote HYP-0009. A later screen is allowed only if the learned VM is exact in every cell, recovers executable programs, is non-dominated by enumerative MDL and oracle on declared full-system axes, survives new noise positions and at least three seeds, and explicitly acknowledges SRC-0039 through SRC-0042.
research_question: Can a compact differentiable latent-state machine infer an unseen recurrent program solely from noisy whole-program input-output examples, extrapolate execution to longer held-out tapes with work bounded by the active prefix rather than padded memory K, and provide any exact capability-cost advantage over explicit enumerative MDL synthesis?
title: Latent two-state VM induction from noisy whole-program I/O
